title: Fix Forms Blueprint Panel Layout Overlap
description: The "semio · forms" app's Blueprint panel (left side of the forms editor, framework/renderer/react/ui-interpreter.tsx) renders question-list sections (Identity, Geometry, Text/Note/Number question editors) that visually overlap on top of each other instead of stacking. Root cause: interpretUiNode's "stack" case wraps every child in a div with flex-1 + min-h-0/min-w-0 with no flex-basis:auto fallback or overflow guard, so in a flex-col container all children are forced to equal flex-basis-0 regardless of actual content height, causing taller children (sections with headings + toggles) to overflow into siblings. Fix the layout so stack children size to content by default and only grow/shrink when explicitly needed, eliminating the overlap shown in the Blueprint panel.
summary:
Root cause: interpretUiNode's "stack" case (framework/renderer/react/ui-interpreter.tsx) wrapped every stack child in a div with `min-h-0 min-w-0 flex-1` (flex-basis:0 + forced min-height:0). When any ancestor in the window chrome ended up height-constrained, this let every child (question cards, nested step Sections) shrink below its natural content height while `overflow: visible` still painted the full content — so the Blueprint panel's per-step Section blocks (e.g. "Identity" and "Geometry") rendered on top of each other instead of stacking sequentially, and individual cards within a step also lost their proportional sizing.

Fix: changed the per-child wrapper to className="flex-auto" (flex: 1 1 auto), dropping the forced flex-basis:0 and min-height:0. This restores CSS's default `min-height: auto` for flex items, so children size to content first and only distribute leftover space — eliminating the shrink-below-content overlap — while children that legitimately need to fill/scroll (Tree, VirtualFileSystem, World3dHost, etc.) already declare their own min-h-0/flex-1/overflow-auto and are unaffected.

Verified in forms-react-dev (localhost:6558): Blueprint panel's Identity step cards (Text·name, Long Text·description, Material, Tags, Prefab, Install Date, Accent Color) and Geometry step cards (Note·info-note, Number·count, height-factor, offset, geometry, reference-image, spec-file) now stack sequentially with no overlap, confirmed via DOM bounding-rect measurements (each stack's top now begins where the previous one ends) and screenshots at multiple scroll positions.

Note: this session had heavy concurrent-dev churn on this exact file (ui-interpreter.tsx) — the fix was overwritten once mid-session by another dev's edit and had to be reapplied; final on-disk state has the flex-auto-only wrapper.
